periods.description: The New Kingdom's special settlement for Lux and Airi: Lux works as a public chore servant to repay a huge debt while Airi remains under royal supervision as hostage counterpart.
periods.principles: Surviving Arcadia royals are spared but marked by black collars, debt, compulsory service, and mutual liability conditions.
periods.classification: special royal pardon, debt labor, hostage monitoring.
periods.origin: Post-coup compromise allowing Lux and Airi to survive despite old imperial blood.
limitations: Lux cannot freely refuse public duties
if Lux commits crimes or flees, Airi may be punished
